whisper.text: Or you could visit Mary Magdalene and her sister Marta, and they'd give me this dinner.

original_qwen.text: Or he could visit Mary Magdalene and our sister Marta, and they give me dinner.

whisper.text: Nid oes cwestiynau yn cael eu gofyn. Felly mae'n dda bod Jesus wedi penderfynu i fod wedi codi'n ddewist yn y lle hwnnw. Oherwydd os oedd wedi codi yng Nghymru, fe fyddai'n cael ei gasglu.

original_qwen.text: No questions asked. So it's a good thing Jesus decided to be born Jewish in that nice warm place, because if he was born in Limerick, he'd catch the consumption.
